class_name: 添加-非限定-ニカギラズ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

patterns.usage_note: Written に限らず. It takes a bare noun and then opens outward: the statement holds beyond the named item, whether the follow-up is a coordinate case (子供に限らず大人も) or an outright wider set (日本に限らずどこの国でも); what it cannot do is name an unrelated item with no shared predicate. It is the written, slightly formal counterpart of だけでなく and usually leans on a following も. Its affirmative counterparts are に限り／に限って ("only in the case of"); the evaluative に限る ("nothing beats") is a separate item despite the shared kanji.

examples.ruby: この病気[びょうき]は大人[おとな]に限[かぎ]らず、子供[こども]もかかる。
examples.english: This illness isn't confined to adults; children come down with it too.

examples.ruby: 渋滞[じゅうたい]は週末[しゅうまつ]に限[かぎ]らず、平日[へいじつ]の朝[あさ]にも起[お]きる。
examples.english: Traffic jams aren't just a weekend thing; they happen on weekday mornings as well.

examples.ruby: 電子[でんし]決済[けっさい]は都会[とかい]に限[かぎ]らず地方[ちほう]でも広[ひろ]がっている。
examples.english: Electronic payment is spreading beyond the big cities into the regions too.
